newsitem.title: USA: Brightpoint adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Brightpoint adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Brightpoint Inc said Friday its board of directors adopted a stockholder rights agreement.

Under certain circumstances, including those involving the acquisition of the company by a holder of at least 15 percent of the company's common stock, or involving the acquisition of at least 15 percent of the company's common stock, all rights holders except the acquirer may purchase shares having a value of twice the exercise price of the rights.
The exercise price of the rights is $115, the company said.
A company spokesperson was unavailalbe to say if the plan was in response to a specific takeover attempt.
